== Biography ==
Helen was born on 25 December 1797 and baptised on 1 January 1798 in Barony parish, Lanarkshire. She is the daughter of [[Glasgow-1348|John Glasgow]] and [[Smith-230548|Helen Smith]]. The transcript records her father as John Glasgow, occupation “Manufr”, her mother as Helen Smith, and the residence as “Andn”. These abbreviated words are left uninterpreted; Barony is the recorded parish, not separate proof of her exact birthplace.<ref name="FMP-OPR-0396291">Findmypast, “Scotland, Parish Births & Baptisms 1564–1929,” Helen Glasgow, birth 25 December 1797, baptism 1 January 1798, Barony, Lanarkshire, parents John Glasgow and Helen Smith; citing OPR 622/4, item 2, p. 43, [https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=SCOT%2FOPR%2FBAP%2F0396291 transcript] (reviewed 23 October 2026).
